programs.description: Ajay falls in love with Ayesha, a fellow college student who is the daughter of a rich businessman. However, problems arise when Ayesha's father arranges her marriage to an associate's son.
Vaishali, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, is blessed with a boon to transform herself into a shapeshifting snake. She falls into a dilemma when circumstances force her to go against her love.
After witnessing a murder committed by a gangster, Tanya flees to Dubai. Karan, who loves her, goes after her only to realise that she is pursued by a few more suitors and the gangster himself.
A flirtatious photographer juggles three air hostesses behind his fiancée's back. However, the facade unravels when his friend-turned-enemy starts snooping around.
When Prakash's father dies, he is forced to shoulder the financial responsibilities of his large family. However, his troubles increase when his younger brother leaves him home to join a gang.
Arjun, a youngster, works at a hotel owned by Raja and serves him faithfully. However, when he learns about a plot to kill Raja, he decides to save him from harm at any cost.
Krishna worships his master, Sahabji, but circumstances lead to his ouster from the house. He works hard, becomes a powerful man and returns to restore his master's honour.
The lives of Raju, Shyam and Baburao change completely when they get cheated by a fraudster. Desperate to repay a loan from a feared gangster, they scramble to find an alternative solution.
A headstrong policeman and a simple-minded bike dealer embark on a high-speed pursuit of a handsome motorcyclist who has been thieving around in Mumbai.

After years of blindness caused by an accident, Naina gets a successful cornea transplant. However, she soon begins to see terrifying visions that prompt her to investigate the source of her sight.
India 1974; Thriller; Dir. Ravi Tandon; Cast: Amitabh Bachchan, Parveen Babi. Ravi leads a good life with his mother & sister. When he learns that he is ill, he falsely takes the blame for a murder.
Bringing the best in television.
An idealist elder brother lands in a dilemma after he misplaces his little sister's shoes. Unable to afford a new pair, the siblings agree to share the shoes, leading to several escapades.

Raju is hired to pose as uncle to three orphaned kids in order to usurp their inheritance. But he changes his mind after falling in love with their governess and decides to fight the greedy relatives.
The daughter of a rich tycoon helps Arjun become a singing star. However, she falls in love with him, unaware that he is already in love with another girl.
Swept up in a whirlwind of fear and romance, Kiran teeters on the edge of a mental and emotional precipice. While Sunil keeps holding on to her, Rahul spares no effort to drag her down with himself.
A conniving son throws his aged parents out of the house. Years later, he meets the same fate when his son decides to teach him a lesson.
Orphaned and separated at a young age, two brothers grow up in opposing dimensions of society, only to cross paths years later as a policeman and a criminal.

A young woman who works as a chef faces various challenges as she tries to maintain a balance between her personal and professional commitments.
A deputy commissioner and his crew attempt to transport a terrorist to Mumbai, but their mission is thwarted by an ex-policeman with an agenda of his own.
After his stepfather is murdered, Sahil gets arrested, but he manages to escape prison to prove his innocence. However, Inspector Udham Singh sets off to capture him.
Karan, a gangster, falls in love with Kajal, but she marries Raju because of her father's poor health. Later, when Raju finds out about his father's illegal business, Karan is hired to kill him.
A newly-wed man discovers that his wife is in love with another man and decides to unite them. Ignoring the ridicule he might have to face for this, he takes his wife to Italy in search of her love.
Prem's heart fills with despair when the woman he loves fails to show up for their wedding day. However, his life soon takes an unexpected turn with the arrival of a new neighbour.
Raj revamps his deceased father's car into a wonderful car named Taarzan and the car comes alive as it is possessed by his father's spirit. Soon, it also starts killing his father's murderers.
Jeeva, a young man, becomes a professional assassin after the death of his family and girlfriend. Later, he meets Kiran and takes her under his wing so that she can avenge her family.

Sunil expresses his love for Pinky, and they enjoy each other's company. However, the ones who are against their relationship create misunderstandings between them and that leads to a breakup.
Shankar's village is living under the terror of the dacoit, Jay Singh. In an attempt to restore peace, Shankar makes a promise to defeat the bandits.
Ranjit and Harbanslal, two rich businessmen, hatch a malicious plan when they discover that their children have fallen in love with individuals from the poorer sections of society.
Shankar teams up with a police inspector, Mangal, and a runaway convict, Vijay, to bring the bandit, Kala Daku, to justice for murdering his father and other crimes.
A decorated school teacher's life is upended by devastating rumours, which ultimately lead to his death. His son Kundan now seeks vengeance.
Sapna is raised by her three uncles, each one of them with a contrasting pursuit in life. She falls in love with Raja, who tries to impress each of her uncles differently.
Naina, who is betrothed to an influential man, falls in love and elopes with Karan, the son of an employee of her fiancé. Soon, bounty hunters start hunting the duo to claim a hefty reward.
Yeshwant, an honest police inspector, is framed and arrested for a murder. However, after being released from prison, he learns that his wife is having an affair.
Vijay leads a life of crime as a result of his troubled past, while Ravi, his younger brother, becomes an honest policeman. Things go awry when Ravi is sent to arrest Vijay.

Life changes for Surya, a young boy from Mumbai when he returns home following communal riots. He goes on to become a carrom champion and is pursued by Jaleel, head of a betting syndicate.
Despite being brothers, Vijay and Vicky Saigal are poles apart. One is a workaholic while the other is a playboy. However, they end up falling in love with the same woman.
Muskaan meets Suraj at a university and falls in love with him. However, to marry her, Suraj must also win over Muskaan's overprotective brother, who takes an immediate dislike towards him.

Om, a junior film artist, is smitten by Shantipriya, a renowned actress, but is killed while trying to save her from a fire accident. Thirty years later, he is reborn and sets out to avenge her death.
Rahul, the adopted older son of a rich couple, is banished by his father when he chooses to marry a middle-class woman. Years later, his younger brother, Rohan, sets out to find him.
The universe offers a Banjara tribe leader's daughter an opportunity to turn her doomed love story into a happily-ever-after with her soulmate.
Friends Vikas and Sunil, along with their girlfriends, Ayesha and Mamta, unknowingly become a part of an awful terrorist plot to kill a minister.

programs.showName: Bal Hanuman Return Of The Demon
programs.description: Bal Hanuman and his friends join together to defeat the crocodile demon who has been brought to life in order to create havoc on Earth.
Jai, a man who is visually impaired, discovers that he has a twin brother, Kishen, who was separated from him on the day his father was murdered. Thus, begins his quest for revenge with his sibling.
Indian soldiers embark on a high-stakes mission to reclaim strategic positions infiltrated by enemy forces, facing extreme conditions and intense battles in a relentless war.
A man and a woman come from two feuding families and pretend to be in love for revenge. Their plan goes awry when they fall in love, and they must work on bringing together their families.
Two brothers struggle to keep their family together as external forces like the younger brother's father-in-law try to break them apart.
Stepbrothers Aftab and Jai, who loathe each other, must learn to put aside their differences and work together to prove their innocence in a terrorism case.
Sanjana is desperate to revive her hopeless relationship with Rahul. However, when the brooding and mysterious Shekhar comes along, her heart starts gravitating towards a new possibility.
Ram Jaane, an orphan, grows up to be a criminal. His social worker friend tries to reform him, but Ram is keener to win over his childhood love, Bela, than turning over a new leaf.

Vinod Joshi witnesses a murder and helps the police during the investigation. After the culprit is arrested, the Joshi family suddenly becomes wealthy and Vinod's wife learns of a dark secret.
When two cops frame Amar, a businessman, of murdering his uncle, he pretends to be of unsound mind to escape apprehension and find the real murderer.
An honest schoolteacher commits suicide due to the actions of the family of a man he testified against. In retaliation, his son takes the law into his own hands and seeks revenge.
Azad, a wealthy prosperous king, is locked in a dungeon by General Dyer who wants to take over his kingdom. Years later, Azad's son comes to his father's rescue and puts an end to Dyer's tyranny.
A gangster named Vijay wants to defeat Kancha, a man who callously killed his father years ago. He is ready to go to any length to restore his family's honour and avenge his father's death.
After a journalist helps to release him from prison, a man agrees to work as a hitman for her, leading him to entangle with a battle between two drug lords.
Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.
DCP Hari Om Patnaik, along with his reformed force, takes up the challenge to make Mumbai crime-free. However, things take a turn for the worse when they lose two of their team members.

A young man claims to be a horse-breeder's long-lost son, but all is not as it seems when he falls in love with the horse-breeder's daughter.
After his wife Rukmini is abducted by his cruel brother, Vishwam is forced to confront the deep-rooted issues of power and control that plague their village, leading to tragic consequences.
Ranvir and Rajvir, two inseparable brothers, support each other through thick and thin. However, they find themselves in a dilemma when both of them fall in love with the same woman.
Veer, a villager, becomes restless after he is haunted by the visions of his past. When he is attacked on the day of his wedding, he forces his parents to reveal the truth about his identity.
When Lieutenant Suraj goes missing, his father believes he is dead and decides to keep the news from his daughter and his son's wife. However, they already know and choose to put up a brave front.
Radhe Mohan, a former college troublemaker, falls in love with Nirjara. However, during a violent encounter with goons, Radhe sustains a head injury that causes him to lose his memories.
Salman and Rukhsar's love brings two warring families face to face, only for tradition, dowry demands and heartbreak to test their fragile bond.
When the war breaks out between India and Pakistan, riots erupt in North India. Later, BSF trooper Tarun and his battalion are sent to Kargil, where they face a challenge that will decide his fate.
